steps.text:
No world region meets **all four** of the 2020 criteria simultaneously in the UN data for that year. In every region available in the UN Data Commons (UN data.un.org) the following holds:

| Criteria | 2020 UN data (regional estimates) | Assessment |
|----------|------------------------------------|------------|
| **Internet penetration (< 80 % of people)** | All African regions were `< 60 %`; all other regions were `≥ 80 %` | Satisfied in Africa only |
| **Male life expectancy > 65 years** | Sub‑Saharan and Southern Africa were `≤ 65 y`; Northern/Western Europe, North America, Australia, etc. were `> 65 y` | Satisfied in most non‑African regions |
| **Unemployment < 15 %** | Many regions (especially many African and South‑East Asian regions) reported unemployment ≥ 15 %; the few regions with < 15 % were mainly in North America, Europe, and Australia | Satisfied in some non‑African regions |
| **Rural safely‑managed sanitation > 50 %** | Rural sanitation coverage was `< 50 %` in all listed African sub‑regions; in most other regions it was > 50 % | Satisfied only in non‑African regions |

Because each of the four conditions is fulfilled by **different** sets of regions, there is **no overlap** where a single region satisfies *all four simultaneously*.  

Hence, **no world region (or sub‑region such as Eastern, Middle, Southern, Western Africa) meets the combined 2020 UN‑data criteria**.
